description_en: Queries a list of associated sources
kebab_example: aliyun mse list-service-source --gateway-unique-id gw-c51a15c7ee934a4fb945ccf35fe10000 --source MSE --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceSource

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the type of the returned service source. If this parameter is not specified, service sources of all types are returned. Valid values:

K8s: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) instance.

MSE Nacos: MSE

MSE ZooKeeper: MSE_ZK

SAE: SAE

EDAS: EDAS
parameters.help_zh:
获取指定服务来源类型（为空返回所有类型）：
容器服务：K8s
MSE Nacos：MSE
MSE ZooKeeper：MSE_ZK
SAE 注册中心：SAE
EDAS 注册中心：EDAS
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
